text: {"features":[{"name":"Team mandate understanding","description":"Shows how well the letter demonstrates an accurate, specific grasp of what this Information Security Engineering role actually does.","levels":[{"score":1,"descriptor":"Shows generic interest in security or backend engineering with no clear sign that the writer understands this team's specific work."},{"score":2,"descriptor":"Mentions one job theme, such as automation or secure development, but describes the role in broad terms."},{"score":3,"descriptor":"Connects the application to several relevant parts of the job, such as security tooling, vulnerability response, or developer support, without much nuance."},{"score":4,"descriptor":"References multiple concrete responsibilities, such as triage automation, AI agents, back-end systems, or lifecycle security, showing solid grasp of the mandate."},{"score":5,"descriptor":"Demonstrates nuanced understanding of the charter by tying together specific responsibilities, cross-functional context, and why the problems matter at Google's scale."}]},{"name":"Role motivation","description":"Shows how convincingly the letter explains why this applicant wants this specific role and team.","levels":[{"score":1,"descriptor":"Gives little reason for wanting this job beyond generic interest in a new role or a well-known company."},{"score":2,"descriptor":"Expresses broad interest in security or scale, but the motivation could fit many engineering roles."},{"score":3,"descriptor":"Gives a believable reason for wanting foundational security work, though the personal connection is only moderately developed."},{"score":4,"descriptor":"Presents clear, role-specific motivation rooted in the applicant's values, prior experiences, or preferred way of working."},{"score":5,"descriptor":"Makes the role feel like a natural next step through compelling, authentic motivation that connects past trajectory to future contribution."}]},{"name":"Security partnership orientation","description":"Shows how strongly the letter presents the applicant as someone who will work effectively with security specialists and adjacent partners.","levels":[{"score":1,"descriptor":"Says nothing meaningful about working with security specialists or cross-functional partners."},{"score":2,"descriptor":"Uses generic teamwork language without showing how the applicant would partner in a security setting."},{"score":3,"descriptor":"Signals willingness to work with security engineers or learn the domain, but without concrete framing."},{"score":4,"descriptor":"Clearly presents the role as partnership with security practitioners, product teams, or both, and shows respect for their expertise."},{"score":5,"descriptor":"Shows a strong collaborative posture by emphasizing close work with security specialists, learning from experts, and building tools that fit real partner workflows."}]},{"name":"Software engineering track record","description":"Shows the depth of professional software engineering experience through years, production ownership, and scope of shipped systems.","levels":[{"score":1,"descriptor":"Shows only limited production experience beyond the minimum bar, with narrow evidence of owning running systems."},{"score":2,"descriptor":"Shows early-career experience with some testing, maintenance, or launches, but modest breadth of production ownership."},{"score":3,"descriptor":"Shows solid relevant experience through multiple years of work and clear ownership of several production services."},{"score":4,"descriptor":"Shows strong professional depth through sustained experience and repeated testing, maintenance, and launch of multiple services."},{"score":5,"descriptor":"Shows extensive relevant track record with long duration, broad production scope, and repeated evidence of end-to-end service ownership."}]},{"name":"Go relevance","description":"Shows how strongly the letter establishes Go as a meaningful part of the applicant's production engineering background.","levels":[{"score":1,"descriptor":"Mentions Go only briefly or ambiguously, without establishing real production depth."},{"score":2,"descriptor":"Identifies Go as one language used, but without showing that it is central to recent work."},{"score":3,"descriptor":"Makes clear that Go has been a regular production language in the applicant's background."},{"score":4,"descriptor":"Positions Go as a primary language or daily driver in recent professional work."},{"score":5,"descriptor":"Establishes Go as the core language behind substantial backend or infrastructure systems closely aligned to the role."}]},{"name":"Python depth","description":"Shows how strongly the letter demonstrates hands-on Python experience relevant to automation, tooling, services, or AI agents.","levels":[{"score":1,"descriptor":"Does not mention Python or mentions it only in passing with no evidence of use."},{"score":2,"descriptor":"Notes some Python exposure but gives little sense of regular or production use."},{"score":3,"descriptor":"Shows meaningful Python use in tooling, scripts, or internal services."},{"score":4,"descriptor":"Shows substantial production Python work across automation, services, analysis, or team-critical tooling."},{"score":5,"descriptor":"Presents Python as a deeply used language with production-grade practices or central ownership of important systems."}]},{"name":"Algorithmic fluency","description":"Shows the strength of the applicant's applied command of algorithms and data structures through concrete engineering examples.","levels":[{"score":1,"descriptor":"Gives no meaningful evidence of applied algorithmic skill."},{"score":2,"descriptor":"Claims strong algorithmic ability in general terms but offers no concrete example."},{"score":3,"descriptor":"Provides one clear example of using data structures or algorithms to improve a system."},{"score":4,"descriptor":"Gives a strong applied example on an important workload, such as a hot path, scheduler, graph problem, or streaming pipeline."},{"score":5,"descriptor":"Demonstrates current, high-level algorithmic fluency through specific examples that clearly changed system performance, scalability, or tractability."}]},{"name":"AI experience","description":"Shows the extent and maturity of the applicant's hands-on experience applying AI in production settings.","levels":[{"score":1,"descriptor":"Provides no evidence of hands-on AI work."},{"score":2,"descriptor":"Signals interest in AI or very limited exposure, but not meaningful applied experience."},{"score":3,"descriptor":"Describes some direct AI or LLM usage with at least one concrete shipped or integrated use case."},{"score":4,"descriptor":"Shows production AI experience and acknowledges reliability, evaluation, or safety concerns."},{"score":5,"descriptor":"Demonstrates substantial production AI experience with clear attention to trustworthiness, failure modes, or evaluation discipline."}]},{"name":"Agentic systems design","description":"Shows how well the letter demonstrates experience designing systems that use autonomous or semi-autonomous agents.","levels":[{"score":1,"descriptor":"Gives no evidence of designing agentic or agent-based systems."},{"score":2,"descriptor":"Mentions agents or autonomous tooling vaguely, without design details."},{"score":3,"descriptor":"Describes agentic tooling at a high level, showing basic relevance to the role."},{"score":4,"descriptor":"Explains a concrete agent architecture, often pairing Python agents with Go services or similar control layers."},{"score":5,"descriptor":"Shows end-to-end ownership of agentic systems with explicit boundaries, permissions, auditing, or other strong control structures."}]},{"name":"Security assessment depth","description":"Shows the depth of hands-on experience evaluating systems for security weaknesses through reviews, threat modeling, or similar work.","levels":[{"score":1,"descriptor":"Provides no evidence of conducting security assessments."},{"score":2,"descriptor":"Suggests security interest mainly through adjacent signals, such as certifications or competitions, rather than assessment work."},{"score":3,"descriptor":"States that the applicant has performed security assessments or reviews, but with limited detail."},{"score":4,"descriptor":"Describes concrete assessment methods, such as threat modeling, code review, attack-surface analysis, or fix validation."},{"score":5,"descriptor":"Presents security assessment as substantial hands-on practice, showing depth, range, and a builder's understanding of where implementations break security assumptions."}]},{"name":"Vulnerability workflow automation","description":"Shows the extent to which the letter demonstrates direct experience automating vulnerability intake, triage, routing, or related response workflows.","levels":[{"score":1,"descriptor":"Gives no evidence of work on vulnerability handling or triage automation."},{"score":2,"descriptor":"Expresses interest in automating security workflows but offers no clear example of having done it."},{"score":3,"descriptor":"Mentions building some automation around vulnerability reports or triage, but with limited detail."},{"score":4,"descriptor":"Clearly describes building a system that classifies, routes, prioritizes, or otherwise streamlines vulnerability handling."},{"score":5,"descriptor":"Shows strong ownership of triage automation and explains how it materially reduced manual work or expanded scarce security capacity."}]},{"name":"Scalable impact orientation","description":"Shows how strongly the applicant frames their work in terms of organization-wide leverage rather than isolated feature delivery.","levels":[{"score":1,"descriptor":"Focuses mostly on personal contribution or feature work without showing interest in broader leverage."},{"score":2,"descriptor":"Mentions scale or platform work abstractly but does not develop the idea."},{"score":3,"descriptor":"Shows clear interest in central systems or work whose benefits reach many teams."},{"score":4,"descriptor":"Repeatedly frames impact as inherited by downstream engineers or as multiplying the reach of a small security team."},{"score":5,"descriptor":"Makes scalable leverage a central theme, tying past work and future goals to capacity creation, secure defaults, and organization-wide effect."}]},{"name":"Developer enablement mindset","description":"Shows how well the letter positions security work as helping developers succeed through low-friction tools and defaults.","levels":[{"score":1,"descriptor":"Does not show a meaningful perspective on helping developers succeed through security tooling."},{"score":2,"descriptor":"Gives a generic statement about helping others but no clear enablement mindset."},{"score":3,"descriptor":"Shows awareness that security tooling should support developers rather than burden them."},{"score":4,"descriptor":"Emphasizes reducing friction, making the secure path easier, or designing from close understanding of developer workflows."},{"score":5,"descriptor":"Presents a strong service mindset in which security is embedded through defaults, tooling, and proactive assistance rather than after-the-fact policing."}]},{"name":"Offensive security grounding","description":"Shows the strength of evidence that the applicant has practiced attacker-oriented security through competitions, labs, or certifications.","levels":[{"score":1,"descriptor":"Provides no evidence of offensive security practice or security credentials."},{"score":2,"descriptor":"Shows light security grounding through an entry-level certification or occasional informal practice."},{"score":3,"descriptor":"Shows meaningful offensive interest through recurring capture-the-flag participation or a stronger certification."},{"score":4,"descriptor":"Shows strong offensive grounding through OSCP-level credentials or notable competitive performance."},{"score":5,"descriptor":"Shows exceptional offensive grounding through both demanding hands-on credentials and sustained high-level competitive practice or equivalent evidence."}]},{"name":"Technical initiative","description":"Shows the strength of self-directed engineering effort outside core job duties through personal projects, open-source work, or maintainership.","levels":[{"score":1,"descriptor":"Offers no meaningful evidence of self-directed technical work outside formal job duties."},{"score":2,"descriptor":"Mentions a small personal project or occasional external contribution with limited scope."},{"score":3,"descriptor":"Shows consistent outside initiative through a maintained side project or recurring open-source contributions."},{"score":4,"descriptor":"Demonstrates substantial initiative through open-source maintainership or an ambitious self-built system with real technical depth."},{"score":5,"descriptor":"Shows exceptional initiative through both technically demanding independent builds and visible stewardship of software used by others."}]},{"name":"Engineering rigor","description":"Shows how strongly the letter signals habits of building dependable systems with guardrails, maintainability, and production discipline.","levels":[{"score":1,"descriptor":"Gives little evidence that reliability, guardrails, or maintainability are active design concerns."},{"score":2,"descriptor":"Uses general language about care or quality but without concrete signs of disciplined engineering."},{"score":3,"descriptor":"Shows some rigor through mentions of dependable systems, maintainability, or a maintainer mindset."},{"score":4,"descriptor":"Gives concrete signals of production discipline, such as typed or tested services, logging, bounded actions, or explicit constraints."},{"score":5,"descriptor":"Makes rigor central to the applicant's approach, with repeated evidence of audits, permissions, evaluations, guardrails, or reliability-first design choices."}]},{"name":"Evidence specificity","description":"Shows how concretely the letter substantiates claims with observable examples, ownership, and outcomes.","levels":[{"score":1,"descriptor":"Relies mostly on broad assertions with little concrete evidence of what the applicant actually built or improved."},{"score":2,"descriptor":"Includes a few specifics, but most claims remain general or unsupported."},{"score":3,"descriptor":"Provides several concrete examples of systems, tasks, or accomplishments with clear ownership."},{"score":4,"descriptor":"Uses specific examples consistently and often adds design choices, problem context, or plausible outcomes."},{"score":5,"descriptor":"Substantiates the case throughout with precise examples that show ownership, mechanisms, and clear consequences for the team or system."}]},{"name":"Writing polish","description":"Shows the professional quality of the writing through clarity, grammar, spelling, and ease of reading.","levels":[{"score":1,"descriptor":"Contains frequent errors or awkward phrasing that noticeably distract from the message."},{"score":2,"descriptor":"Has recurring mistakes or clumsy wording, though the overall meaning remains understandable."},{"score":3,"descriptor":"Reads clearly overall but includes some errors or rough edges."},{"score":4,"descriptor":"Is clean and professional with only minor slips that do not meaningfully affect credibility."},{"score":5,"descriptor":"Is polished, concise, and essentially error-free throughout."}]},{"name":"Professional voice","description":"Shows whether the letter has a distinctive, coherent point of view that makes the candidate memorable beyond a checklist match.","levels":[{"score":1,"descriptor":"Reads like interchangeable boilerplate with no clear professional identity or throughline."},{"score":2,"descriptor":"Has a mildly personal opening or framing, but most of the letter still feels generic."},{"score":3,"descriptor":"Presents a recognizable perspective or theme, though it is not carried strongly through the full letter."},{"score":4,"descriptor":"Uses a clear professional throughline that reinforces fit and makes the letter more memorable."},{"score":5,"descriptor":"Delivers a distinctive, cohesive voice that makes the applicant's perspective and fit feel vivid rather than templated."}]}]}
